purpose: The analyst-recognition band: a section title over a framed strip of signed quotes — one per report, marked by the firm's logo — that scrolls continuously and pauses on hover, on focus or from its pause control; the loop is the one `marquee` runs on. It is a page section — the site places it from a `{ _id: 'recognition-marquee-section', props }` entry and binds `props` straight onto it — and it composes `module`, `module-header`, `registration-frame` and `quote`.
useWhen: Use RecognitionMarqueeSection only for a looping row of analyst or press quotes.
To list analyst reports and awards on a page that needs third-party proof.
related: `quote` — the signed card each recognition renders with.
`photo-marquee-section` — the sibling strip of pictures with the same loop.
bestPractices: Five to eight items; the loop needs enough width to read as continuous.
Leave `duration` at `0` to let the strip pace itself (twelve seconds per item).
